kicad_pcb version 20260206, pcbnew 10.0

# board (14)
general (thickness 1.6) (legacy_teardrops no)
paper A4
layer F.Cu signal
layer B.Cu signal
layer Edge.Cuts user
stackup "F.Cu" (type "copper") (thickness 0.035)
stackup "dielectric 1" (type "core") (thickness 1.51) (material "FR4") (epsilon_r 4.5)
stackup "B.Cu" (type "copper") (thickness 0.035)
stackup (copper_finish "ENIG")
setup pad_to_mask_clearance 0.05
plot outputdirectory "gerbers/"
plot mirror no
property BOARD_NUMBER=B999A
outline 30 x 20 mm

# footprints (2)
R10 10k  fp=Resistor_SMD:R_0402_1005Metric  side=top  rot=270  smd
  Mpn1=RC0402FR-0710KL
  model ${KICAD10_3DMODEL_DIR}/Resistor_SMD.3dshapes/R_0402_1005Metric.step
  pad 1 /SDA
  pad 2 +3V3
U1 LM358  fp=Package_SO:SOIC-8  side=bottom  rot=180  smd  dnp
  variant Plus dnp=no
  pad 3 /SDA (IN)
  pad 4 GND (V-)
  pad 5 -

# nets (3)
net +3V3  pads=1 tracks=0 vias=0
net /SDA  pads=2 tracks=2 vias=1
net GND  pads=1 tracks=0 vias=0

# copper (3)
F.Cu  tracks=1 arcs=0 zones=1
B.Cu  tracks=1 arcs=0 zones=1
via 0.6/0.3 F.Cu-B.Cu

# zones (1)
zone GND F.Cu,B.Cu ground  (connect_pads (clearance 0.2)) (min_thickness 0.2) (fill yes (thermal_gap 0.3) (thermal_bridge_width 0.3))

# graphics (1)
gr_rect Edge.Cuts

# text (1)
gr_text F.SilkS "B999A rev A"

# other (2)
(embedded_fonts no)
(future_item "kept" (value 42))
